explanation: Use both cosine and sine at the forcing frequency 6 because differentiation interchanges them. The matrix has only eigenvalue 1, so there is no resonance with ±6i and no extra exponential or t factor is needed. Substituting x_p=a cos(6t)+b sin(6t) gives 6b=Aa and -6a=Ab+(-1,3)^T; these equations are solvable since A²+36I is invertible.
